up: Return all IC50 activity records for Chloroquine (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL76) and any of its salt forms, tested against Plasmodium falciparum (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL364). For each record, include the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, activity record details (standard value, units, relation, pChEMBL value), assay ChEMBL ID, assay description, and the literature reference (PubMed ID or DOI). Expand the compound set to include all salt forms by using the molecule hierarchy table to find the parent compound and all its children.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
  SELECT parent.molregno, parent.chembl_id, parent.pref_name
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL76'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id, child.pref_name
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL76'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  strct.canonical_smiles,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.pchembl_value,
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  ass.description,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM compound_set cs
JOIN activities act ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures strct ON strct.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL364'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50';
